module: Mission routes (Vue, abstract): details (back via missionDetailsExitHandler), mission control (back pause; grid vehicle selector with gridSelector backendName vehicleSelector), grid, drag history and rules, AI competitors leaderboard.
notes: Route configuration module: it exports no function. routeManager reads it (via the ui_router_routes_<name> extension) when routes.lua includes it with `{ include = "<name>" }`.
The keys of `Children` form the segments of the dotted name: "<module>.<child>". `children` (lowercase) in a node designates its sub-routes; `include` mounts another module there.
`ui` is inherited by child routes (uiTypes, uiTypesFilter, infoBar, topBar, uiApps, uiNav, triggerPause): a child redefines it only for what changes.

Root.desc: {screenId = "mission", abstract = true, ui = Vue only, default infoBar, topBar hidden, default uiApps}

Children.desc: details, control (> vehicleSelector with hooks ui_gridSelectorRouteLifecycleCallbacks.onRouteEnter/Mount/Leave and meta.gridSelector {backendName, routePath = "/mission-vehicle-selector", defaultPath}), grid, dragHistory, dragRules, aiCompetitorsLeaderboardTable.

ModuleName.desc: Name of the routes module (first segment of the dotted name).
